name: effort-change-mid-turn-restarts-with-resume-after-the-turn
description: Cycle Effort pressed while a turn is in flight only queues the change. Once the turn completes, PowerUp restarts the harness with the new effort and resumes the same session, so the conversation carries on.
reason: Effort has no live switch: it only changes by relaunching the CLI with --effort and --resume. Restarting at once would kill the answer being written, so the restart waits for the turn to finish.
source: DESIGN.md v1.2 E '.cycleEffort' (pendingEffortRestart honored on the next .turnCompleted, restart with resume) and v2.0 'cycleEffort refuses when !harness.supportsEffort'; AppState.cycleEffort / restartForEffort / handleHarnessEvent(.turnCompleted)

script.reason: App launch: no saved conversation, so a fresh session starts with effort medium.
A turn is now in flight.
Medium → High mid-turn: the change is queued, nothing is restarted yet.
The answer arrives in full; the queued restart still waits for the turn's end.
The turn is over: the queued effort change now restarts the harness with --resume.

transcript.text: Effort → High (applies when this turn finishes)
Resuming the session with effort high…
